reason: Read-only token audit of Eventar app/ and components/ found Tailwind classes that name no defined token (text-title-md, text-title-sm, text-label-lg, rounded-xxl, py-2xl, gap-2xl) and a type/radius scale that disagrees between Design Language.md and globals.css. Next frontend coherence pass needs this trap and the open ruling recorded where the next session will look.
The undefined-class sweep failed on zsh glob expansion, and the skill gives no sweep recipe. Comment hits would also count as uses if not read.

Rule 6 said to align to neither source until Ivan rules, but Ivan approved a Batch 1 swap set on 2026-11-16. The skill named dead classes without a replacement, so the next session had nothing to apply. The approved map is added and rule 6 is reconciled with it.

The typography round added a fluid clamp to headline-lg and a new text-hero token. Without this note the scale rule reads as if both were never approved, and the next session would either reject them or treat them as precedent for more.
Trigger widened: the type-token registration and typography copy rules below were not reachable from the index line, so a session adding a text token or writing copy would not load this skill.
A subagent added --text-hero to globals.css and the full vitest run failed on lib/utils.test.ts until the name was registered in TYPE_SCALE and the test list. Recurring trap for every new text token.

Ivan's 2026-11-20 typography ruling: curly quotes in user-facing text, and acronyms get `<abbr>` only with no small-caps. A subagent sweep was briefed on it, so the rule needs a home in the skill a future typography session loads.

A colour token value change on 2026-11-20 (four container inks, --outline-variant, dark --popover) moved the FDS vault table, which kept old hexes until a later manual check. The FDS update also left dark pairs unrecomputed. The skill covers token edits but not colour value changes, so its trigger and a step for the vault doc are missing.
Companion patch: the new colour-change step, placed before the audit pointer so the rule is numbered with the others.

Ivan set a unit policy for frontend code: px was pinning layout and broke nav, tap targets and the 640px overflow. New and edited lines must use rem for text, % for layouts, viewport units for fullscreen sections, px for borders only. This supersedes "match the convention" (CLAUDE.md rule 11) for new code only, so the skill that governs Eventar sizing classes must carry it.
The unit rule needs a trigger word a user would type (px, rem, vw, dvh). Without it the skill does not load when Ivan asks about sizing units.

Ivan approved the px sweep on 2026-11-21, which supersedes rule 11's "do not sweep unasked". The sweep also produced two non-obvious conversion rules (exact fractions, token classes not zero-diff) that a future batch would otherwise rediscover the hard way.

Batch 2 added custom radius tokens, and tailwind-merge only merges keys it knows. The rule for `--text-*` (rule 8) has no radius equivalent, so a new `--radius-*` token could sit beside `rounded-xl` in cn() without being merged out.

Sweep Batches 2-5 left a calc() with a px term beside rem terms on the landing audience toggle. Default-size render showed no diff, so only a non-default-root review caught it. The rule is a durable conversion and verification step, not a Ivan-decision item.

The dev-lens review found a plan claim (all remaining px calc sites in one folder) false by grep, px leftovers in changed files outside the codemod's list, and a poster file edited though the plan lists poster print code as out of scope. Each is a sweep-completeness and scope rule for this skill's batch procedure.

Ivan's 2026-11-21 unit rule (text rem, layouts %, fullscreen viewport units, px borders) is violated by the shipped T2 clamps, which put vw inside text. The rule as written does not say vw-in-text is banned, and the ratchet only counts px, so the gap is silent. An agent reading rule 11 would otherwise treat the clamps as compliant or copy the pattern.
The 2026-11-21 hero round lost a fix to @theme inline value copying. A future session editing a fluid or stepped token needs the indirection pattern and a computed-value check, not a screenshot.

Ivan's unit rule from 2026-11-21 is not in this skill, and the assistant had to be told it was broken in a row-4 proposal. Putting it here makes the next frontend edit check units before writing them.

Episode found and fixed a real bug: a Tailwind v4 utility (text-trim) was silently dropped by tailwind-merge in cn(), so the button lost its trim whenever a text colour followed it. The fix lives in the shared config, and the skill has no rule covering unknown utilities that cn() evicts. Rule 13 covers radii only.
